type.description: The type of the content part.

text.description: The text content. Required when type is text.

image_url.description: The image URL content. Required when type is image_url.

url.description: Either a URL of the image or the base64 encoded image data.

detail.description:
Specifies the detail level of the image. low uses fewer
tokens; high enables detailed image understanding.

input_audio.description: The audio content. Required when type is input_audio.

format.description: The format of the encoded audio data.
